purpose: Study Resident Evil 2 Remake, Resident Evil 3 Remake, and Resident Evil Village Nexus model-modding ecosystems for modular character construction, mesh replacement, component swaps, physics-chain authoring, texture mutation, silhouette control, and outfit/body separation. No Capcom game assets or third-party Nexus binaries may enter LuHm runtime unless independently licensed for that use.

studyTargets: separate hair face and outfit modules
rig reuse and manual weight cleanup
